meaning: Pair the existing PMIC minimal-init workaround with the same-SoC SPMI transaction-wrapper bypass. Preserve driver registration. This is a bring-up workaround, not working PMIC writes.
evidence: v10 QcomChargerDxeLA -> PmicDxe -> SPMI return RVA 0x15C0, faulting at RVA 0x37F0 with FAR=0x0C77A008. TB520FU wrapper 0x154C..0x15FB is byte-identical to the unpatched Giulia wrapper; its published patch changes these same eight bytes.
limitations: The wrapper returns zero without hardware I/O. Do not interpret this as valid battery or charging status. Other SPMI wrappers remain unchanged.
